alerts.headline: Gale Watch issued October 15 at 2:45AM EDT until October 17 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: * WHAT...Northwest winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and waves 2 to 4 feet possible. * WHERE...Narragansett Bay. * WHEN...From Friday evening through Saturday evening. * IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous waves which could capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
alerts.instruction: Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible hazardous conditions. Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
